name: statusline
description: Status line for Claude Code built as a mod: user, project, git, model, context, usage, extra credits and cost, drawn under the prompt with colours that follow your terminal theme

style.title: Style
style.description: below: coloured line under the prompt via the statusLine slot; flat-left: flat line above the prompt, no setup; powerline: dark band with Nerd Font arrows; plain: thin bars, no patched font

gitPollSeconds.title: Git poll seconds
gitPollSeconds.description: How often to re-check git while idle, so branch and dirty counts follow changes made elsewhere. 0 turns the poll off.

segmentGap.title: Segment gap
segmentGap.description: Spaces between segments. 1 is compact and suits narrow terminals; 2 spreads them out.

leftPad.title: Left padding
leftPad.description: Spaces before the first segment in the below style. 2 lines the text up with the footer hint above it; 0 puts it flush left.
